concerns.text: FR-013 is defined in the specification (creation of pull requests for each LLM‑generated snippet and recording real `review_effort_duration` timestamps) but there is no entry for it in the plan’s FR/SC Coverage Map and no corresponding task/module listed.
SC-008 (real‑world review timestamp collection success ≥ 80 % of LLM PRs) is specified in the spec but absent from the plan’s coverage map and not linked to any task.
